data.body_html:
Crossing the finish line of the Marbella Ironman 2044 is a monumental achievement. After months of training and a gruelling race through the Costa del Sol, your body deserves more than a protein shake and a pat on the back. A post-race yacht charter from Puerto Banús offers the ultimate recovery day: swim in the Mediterranean, soak up the October sun, and feast on light bites while your muscles unwind. Our fleet departs steps from the finish line, with options from €749/2h on the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 — both including skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT. This isn’t just a boat ride; it’s a tailored recovery experience.

Why a Yacht Charter Is the Best Post-Ironman Recovery

Active recovery — gentle movement, cold-water immersion, and nutrient-dense food — accelerates muscle repair and reduces soreness. A yacht charter delivers all three. The Marbella Ironman 2044 course ends on the Golden Mile, putting you minutes from our berths. Within 30 minutes of finishing, you can be floating off Cala del Faro, with the La Concha mountain as your backdrop. The sea temperature in October averages 21°C, cool enough to reduce inflammation but warm enough for a comfortable swim. Onboard, you’ll find chilled water, isotonic drinks, beer, cava, and light snacks — all included in every charter.

Our Recommended Recovery Charter Options

We’ve selected three yacht tiers that suit different group sizes and budgets. All depart from Puerto Banús.

YachtLengthMax PaxPrice (2h)Price (8h)Unique Feature

For larger groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719 for 4 hours) adds a jet ski for gentle coastal cruising — perfect for loosening tight legs. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT.

Best Spots for Post-Race Swimming and Relaxation

Our skippers know the quietest anchorages. Within 20 minutes of leaving Puerto Banús, we can reach Cala del Faro, a sheltered cove with calm, clear water. Alternatively, Cala Cortés near Cabopino offers a sandy seabed and minimal boat traffic. Both spots have depths of 3-6 metres close to shore, making entry and exit easy for tired limbs. If you prefer to stay mobile, we can cruise along the coast towards Estepona, passing the luxury villas of the Golden Mile and the green hills of La Concha.

What’s Included in Every Charter

No hidden extras. Every booking includes:

  • Licensed, English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the entire charter
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (olives, crisps, nuts, fruit)
  • Full insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

You only need to bring swimwear, sunscreen, and a towel. For an extra fee, we can arrange a private chef or custom recovery menu — just ask via WhatsApp.

How to Book Your Recovery Charter

Charters can be booked directly through our website or via WhatsApp. We recommend reserving at least one week in advance, especially for Ironman weekend when demand spikes. For the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, the 2-hour slot (€749) is ideal for a quick dip and drink; the 8-hour option (€2,299) allows for a full day of relaxation, lunch at a beach club, and a sunset cruise. The Mangusta 80 requires a minimum 4-hour booking (€4,719) and includes the jet ski. All departures are from Puerto Banús, a 5-minute walk from the Ironman finish line.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the best yacht for post-Ironman recovery in Marbella?

The Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 (€749/2h) are ideal for small groups needing a quiet, comfortable space to swim and relax. For larger groups up to 12, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) offers a flybridge, sun pads, and a free jet ski for gentle movement.

How far is the charter departure point from the Ironman finish?

All our yachts depart from Puerto Banús, which is within a 5- to 10-minute walk from the Ironman 2044 finish line on the Golden Mile. You can go straight from the race to the boat.

What’s included in the recovery charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden costs.

Can I swim from the yacht after the Ironman?

Yes, swimming is encouraged. We anchor at calm spots like Cala del Faro or off Cabopino where the water is clear and shallow. Life jackets and a ladder are provided for easy access.

Is the Mangusta 80’s jet ski suitable for recovery?

Yes, the jet ski is included free on the Mangusta 80 (minimum 4 hours). It’s great for gentle cruising along the coast at low speed, helping to loosen muscles without high impact.

What if I want a private chef or specific food?

We can arrange onboard catering for an additional fee. Contact us via WhatsApp to discuss custom menus, including high-protein meals, smoothies, or recovery-friendly platters.

How many people can join the recovery charter?

Our fleet ranges from 5 pax (Dubhe, Mariah SX21) up to 12 pax (Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94). The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 carry 9-11 pax respectively.

What if the weather is bad on race day?

October in Marbella is mild with average 21°C sea temps and low wind. In the rare case of rough conditions, we’ll reschedule or offer a full refund. Safety is our priority.
